SELECT
TO_CHAR(TRUNC(a.VISIT_DATE, 'MM'), 'YYYY-MM')
TO_CHAR(TRUNC(a.VISIT_DATE), 'YYYY-MM-DD')
AS itemDate, a.OPERATOR_NO AS operNo, COUNT(1) AS rcptCnt, COUNT(DISTINCT a.PATIENT_ID) AS personCnt FROM outp_rcpt_master a WHERE a.VISIT_DATE >= #{startDate} AND a.VISIT_DATE < #{endDate} + 1 AND a.OPERATOR_NO IN
#{op}
AND a.OPERATOR_NO = #{operatorNo}
AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM outp_treat_rec_t t WHERE t.RCPT_NO = a.RCPT_NO AND t.PRE_HOSPITAL <= 1 ) GROUP BY a.OPERATOR_NO,
TRUNC(a.VISIT_DATE, 'MM')
TRUNC(a.VISIT_DATE)
ORDER BY itemDate, operNo

#{id}
SELECT COUNT(1) FROM users WHERE USER_ID LIKE '%' || #{kw} || '%' OR DB_USER LIKE '%' || #{kw} || '%' OR RAWTOHEX(USER_NAME) LIKE '%' || #{kwHex} || '%'
SELECT USER_ID AS operNo, DB_USER AS operDbuser, RAWTOHEX(TRIM(USER_NAME)) AS operNameHex FROM users WHERE DB_USER = #{dbuser} AND ROWNUM = 1
